==Description==
'''Cataclysm''' is a winter-themed [[Maps|map]] that takes place at a factory.

==Design & Path==
{{Tabber
|Current
|'''Cataclysm''' is a factory in a forest during winter. Snowflakes can be seen falling from the sky. On the side of the factory, there is a city, with multiple differently colored buildings. Multiple mountains can also be seen near the factory. The factory itself is a large brown building, with its roof being covered by snow. It has a large amount of windows. It also has a few chimeny stacks, which emit smoke into the air. Multiple box trucks, crates and metal shelves can be seen next to buildings. A statue can also be seen. There are roadblocks near the entrance and exit.

The path starts at a cave and ends at the entrance to the factory.
|Version 1
|'''Cataclysm''' was a destroyed city in a canyon. The canyon was surrounded by snow and dead trees. The city itself was a small affair, with a road system and four road tunnels. There were also two railway tracks in cutting in the city, implying that the city had a cut-and-cover railway. Several buildings could be seen, including a skyscraper, but they had been destroyed. However, a toll building could be seen leading up to power station, which had a chimney stack. A burning heap, a destroyed statue and a destroyed path could be seen, with cones protecting the gap onto the railway cutting. Sandbags and metal gates could also be seen.

The path begins at one of the road tunnels in the mountains and ends at the road tunnel underneath the power station.
}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Hard|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*There are relatively few cliff spots on this map, so the [[Sniper]], [[Ranger]] and [[Mortar]] are not recommended.
*The [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]] are recommended due to their efficient coverage at certain positions, including the entrance.

==Trivia==

**When it was remade in the [[V1.6.0|Violent Night Update]], it was called ''Cataclysm'' in the update log.
